name: Yiyi Tsukropaty
source:
This is a short story about very real mountains and a very real girl who lost a very real thing. Nothing special here. After all, it is absolutely normal to forget some things. 

The number of endings depends on your decision, but you are unlikely to count more than two. Or three. Or just one?

[translated from [url=https://harbourr.itch.io/yii-tsukropaty]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于非常真实的山脉和一个非常真实的女孩失去了非常真实的东西的短篇故事。这里没什么特别的。毕竟，忘记一些事情是绝对正常的。

结局的数量取决于你的决定，但你不可能数到超过两个。或者三个。或者只有一个？

[译自[url=https://harbourr.itch.io/yii-tsukropaty]itch.io[/url]]
